description: This file defines the React component 'EditAssetPage' used for editing asset details in a frontend application. It manages form state, handles data fetching from API endpoints, performs validation, and submits updates to the backend.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: React hook to perform side effects (data fetching when component mounts or dependencies change).

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch asset data from the API when component loads or assetId changes.

methods.name: validation
methods.description: Memoized object containing validation rules for asset form fields.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles the form submission: validation, permission check, API call to update asset, and error handling.
